title: UGIF-DataSet: A New Dataset for Cross-lingual, Cross-modal Sequential actions on the UI

publication.identity_basis: Same work under a revised title: the same three authors in the same order and the same specific contribution in the complete publisher abstract (UGIF-DataSet with 4,184 smartphone tasks across 8 languages, and end-to-end completion falling from 48% for English to 32% for other languages) were reviewed against the retained arXiv identity.
publication.notes: Publisher proceedings edition; retained separately from the arXiv snapshot. The publisher title is 'UGIF-DataSet: A New Dataset for Cross-lingual, Cross-modal Sequential actions on the UI', while the retained arXiv v2 title is 'UGIF: UI Grounded Instruction Following'.
